about: Asset codes (SPEC 'Data Models' > Asset codes). Reference data only: no holding, address or quantity.
Each canonical code lists the source identifiers that name it, matched exactly and with case:
the portfolio tracker's coin identifiers (lower-case slugs) and the exchanges' tickers.
An identifier not listed here gets the code 'unlisted:<identifier>', so a token that prints a real
asset's symbol never pairs with, prices as or nets against the real asset.
